Future<void> run(groups, other, read, output) async {
  for (final batch in groups) {
    report(batch.length);
    final List<Future<Row>> tasks = batch
        .where((item) => item.enabled)
        .map<Future<Row>>(read)
        .toList();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait<Row>(tasks, eagerError: true);
    output.addAll(rows);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = batch.map((item) async {
      final row = await read(item);
      return row;
    }).toList();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    output.addAll(await futures.wait);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final List<Future<Row>> tasks = other.map<Future<Row>>(read).toList();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    final rows = await Future.wait<Row>(tasks);
  }
  for (final batch in groups) {
    final futures = [
      for (final item in batch)
        // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
        await read(item),
    ];
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(futures);
  }
}
